ngaap.guidance: 2020 guidance (Feb-18-2020): GAAP sales ~$8.7bn; GAAP op income ~$1.1bn; GAAP diluted EPS $3.20-$3.50; EBITDA ~$1.6bn; adjusted op income ~$1.4bn; adjusted EBITDA ~$1.6bn; adjusted EPS $4.50-$4.80 (adjusted guidance now excludes recurring purchase price accounting amortization); adjusted op margin ~16%; adjusted ETR ~25.5%; net synergy benefit >$150m in 2020; GAAP CFO ~$900m incl. ~$100m outflows for prior-year restructuring and litigation; Q1-20 expected seasonally lower.
ngaap.notes: 2019 'adjusted' definition (as originally reported): excludes GE Transportation merger costs - transaction & restructuring (and, from Q3, litigation) costs, one-time non-cash purchase price accounting (inventory step-up) charges, non-cash accounting policy harmonization, related merger financing interest and tax on non-deductible transaction costs. Recurring PPA amortization was NOT added back in 2019. EBITDA (2019 definition) = income from operations + depreciation + amortization (other income excluded, so ebitda_other=null); ebitda_dda = depreciation + amortization columns summed. From Q1-20 Wabtec redefined adjusted results (adds back all non-cash intangible amortization and FX losses; drops policy harmonization and one-time PPA in adjusted sales/GP) and EBITDA (= op income + other income + D&A). FY2019 adjusted results include +$91.6m policy harmonization (adjusted sales 8,323.0). Recast under 2020 definition (Q3-20/Q4-20 releases): FY2019 adjusted op income 1,316.3, adjusted EPS $4.86; 2020-definition EBITDA 1,062.1, adjusted EBITDA 1,476.9.

extra.notes: GE Transportation merger closed 25-Feb-2019. Consideration: estimated total value ~$10.3bn incl. cash paid for the Direct Sale assets, equity transferred for SpinCo, contingent consideration, assumed debt, net of cash acquired; cash payment to GE $2.885bn (incl. $10.0m for SpinCo Class B preferred); 46,763,975 Wabtec common shares issued to GE shareholders + 19,018,207 common shares and 10,000 convertible preferred shares to GE (GE holders ~49.2% fully diluted / Wabtec holders ~50.8%), valued at $73.36 closing price (22-Feb-2019); equity issued recorded $6,975.0m (common 0.7 + APIC 6,887.6 + NCI 86.8 per Q1-19 10-Q); fixed $470.0m future payment to GE tied to tax benefits treated as contingent consideration (fair value $440.0m). Funded by $2.5bn senior notes issued Sept-2018 and term loan/revolver. Preliminary PPA (2019 10-K, $m): cash 177.6, receivables 515.5, inventories 1,189.2, other current 71.5, PP&E 1,089.6, goodwill 5,987.5 (Freight; majority tax-deductible), trade names 55.0, customer relationships 550.0, intellectual property 1,180.0, backlog 1,440.0, other noncurrent 330.3; total assets 12,586.2; current liabilities 1,587.5, contingent consideration 440.0, other noncurrent liabilities 652.9 (incl. ~$504.7m unfavorable customer contracts); net assets 9,905.8; NCI 86.8 (GE Transportation Brazil NCI bought out Apr-2019 for $56.2m). Final PPA (2020 10-K): goodwill 5,983.5, backlog 1,450.0, net assets 9,907.3, NCI 88.3, unfavorable contracts ~$524.6m. Merger P&L effects 2019: one-time inventory step-up (PPA) $185.0m in cost of sales; restructuring/transaction/litigation $229.8m op-level + $25.0m interest/other; acquisition costs ~$63.0m in SG&A; recurring PPA amortization not added back in 2019 adjusted results. GE Transportation contributed $3.8bn sales / $358.0m op income in 2019; unaudited pro forma 2019 sales $8,675.6m. GE sold down its entire Wabtec stake via secondary offerings (May-6, Aug-9, Sep-12-2019; no proceeds to Wabtec). Synergy target $250m by year four (later: exceed before 2022). Divestitures: none disclosed in the 2019 10-K/10-Qs (no DOJ-mandated divestiture found in the filings; proceeds from disposals were only PP&E $3.9m). Annax (acq. 2018) contingent consideration $10.1m paid Q2-19. Dividends declared $0.48/share (cash dividends $81.7m).
